# GitHub Repository Metadata

## Description
A Chrome browser extension that adds team-based account switching functionality to GitHub.com pages. Built with TypeScript, Plasmo framework, and modern development tooling.

## Topics
- chrome-extension
- typescript
- plasmo
- github
- browser-extension
- account-switcher
- developer-tools
- web-extension
- manifest-v3
- pnpm

## About
GitHub-Switcher enhances GitHub.com with seamless team account switching. Features include GitHub page detection, centralized logging, and a developer-friendly environment with hot reload, comprehensive testing (100% coverage), and automated CI/CD.
